item.title: The Universe Is Still Speeding Up—Major Analysis Reaffirms Dark Energy’s Dominance
item.description:
The Universe Is Still Speeding Up—Major Analysis Reaffirms Dark Energy’s Dominance

For more than two decades, cosmologists have accepted that the expansion of the universe is accelerating, driven by a mysterious component called dark energy. In recent years, a handful of studies raised the possibility that this acceleration might be slowing or that the data could be reinterpreted without dark energy. A major new analysis published in late August 2026 has now pushed back firmly against those suggestions.

item.title: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope Set to Launch This Weekend—Here’s Why It Could Rewrite Cosmology
item.description:
NASA’s Roman Space Telescope Set to Launch This Weekend—Here’s Why It Could Rewrite Cosmology

NASA is on the verge of launching one of its most ambitious observatories in decades. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, a $4.3 billion mission, is targeted for liftoff no earlier than August 30, 2026, from Florida’s Kennedy Space Center aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket. Named for NASA’s first chief astronomer—a pioneering advocate for space-based telescopes—the Roman observatory is designed to transform our understanding of the cosmos on multiple fronts simultaneously.
